classification: Present since the profile inspection commands were introduced.
evidence: Commit `9abca4255e10446336d4276ba873b08c2691bbd8` (2026-05-15) created both handlers while discarding the global profile flag. It entered the default branch through foundation PR #5 on 2026-07-29 (merge `9ecfe4a493a07f56f70aefbb03e1b6aa88b25c96`). limitations: Actual historical CLI binary and disposable credential-free local profiles. No backend calls. First stable source tag is identified from Git, not a downloaded release binary.
